sources: Grizzled Edge (3 pieces): rmxlinux Json/SkillData/passive_equipsuit_crush_fracture (game 1.6): ATK +atk_up (stat panel) and BuffData buff_equipsuit_crush_fracture: abilityEvent 401 (the wearer applies a physical status) with CheckPhysicalInflictionType mask 12 (Crush, Breach) and the target's Vulnerable (tag 1075718177) >= 1, SaveBuffStackNum: phy_dmg_up = Vulnerable stacks × phy_dmg_up_perstack, × special_multi if the target has Physical Susceptibility (tag 1066759270), buff_common_originum_frozen (anyone's) or no poise left (Staggered) → buff_equipsuit_crush_fracture_physicdamage (attr 50 Physical DMG +phy_dmg_up for `duration` 20 s; stackingType 1 with priority = the value). Description: "When the wearer applies Crush or Breach, the wearer gains Physical DMG Dealt +[{phy_dmg_up_perstack} × Vulnerability stacks consumed] for {duration}s". Batch-2 report docs/kit-batches/batch-2/chr_0003_endminf.md rows 36-40.

Event 401 comes before the status buff's own handlers (which consume Vulnerable and the crystals): the stacks are the event's level, and the crystals check must see the situation at the event. The engine judges a trigger's `if` there but a buff's values when the action runs, after other triggers on the event (the Endministrator's own crystal triggers, team order first) may have ended the crystals; so the sealed case is its own trigger and buff, chosen by `if` at the event (both stand for the one game buff: only the stronger counts, and each ends the other, as a reapplication would replace it). Verified on fixtures/pending/zmdlogs-7e19489ae503.json t=33734: 0.36 = 4 × 0.06 × 1.5 on her own Crush of a sealed, unstaggered enemy without Physical Susceptibility. A Crush or Breach on an enemy without Vulnerable only adds a stack (no physicalStatus event), as the set's Vulnerable >= 1 check requires.
